items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Oh, I heard of them. Yeah, I heard of them. But personally, I don't know them.

ctx.x: Yeah, well we had him play Stickney. He was out there steady. I forget to call it the Red something. Red Arrow. Yeah Red Arrow. Well Al Wynn was with him then. I played out there with Lil Armstrong a couple of times, but he had Al Wynn with him then. I played with him showboat later. When I joined him, I joined him and went in the showboat. Then we went out east and New England did some concerts and things like that. But we're doing pretty nice. Most of August, we work most of August. It's nice pay. I work a…
Barbara Reed used to help promote those dances. Do you remember Barbara and Bill Reed? They used to help promote dances at the Midnight Sun in Chicago.
Oh, I heard of them. Yeah, I heard of them. But personally, I don't know them.
